(a) the use of icons in a database query system facilitates the perception of the structure of the database and improves the performance of the users, (b) the intensional feedback mechanism reduces the number of physical accesses to the data, and (c) the use of natural language improves the performance of users and facilitates the access of the database.

(1) we have designed and implemented a query system that uses a visual interface and a natural language interface, and (2) we have designed an algorithm for intensional feedback, based on the notion of the generalized attribute, that can be used to reduce physical accesses to the database.
